AuditConfig.description: Where the audit journal is written and the key its hashes are made with.

destination.description: Where audit entries go: a rotated `file` (the default) or `stdout`.

hashKeyRef.description: Secret reference to the audit hash key.

path.description: The absolute path of the active audit file, for `destination: file`.

retentionDays.description:
How many days a sealed audit file is kept, for `destination: file`;
90 when omitted.

rotateBytes.description:
The size at which the active file is sealed and a new one begun,
for `destination: file`; 100 MiB when omitted.

AuditDestinationKind.description: The configured audit destination kind, as written in product configuration.

oneOf.description: One JSON line per entry on standard output, flushed per entry.

CleanupConfig.description:
Erasure of the bytes of documents whose custodian asked for their
removal.

ContentVerificationConfig.description:
The content verifier every document version passes before it becomes
releasable.

oneOf.description: An HTTP verifier the runtime asks about each document version.

attemptTimeoutMilliseconds.description:
The longest one verification attempt may run, body included.
Omitted, 10000.

policyId.description: Non-secret identity of the external scanner and its rules generation.

url.description:
The URL the content is posted to. It is `https`; `http` is accepted
only for a loopback host, for local development.

oneOf.description:
No verifier, accepted only beside `tlsTermination:
development-loopback`. Every finalized version is recorded as
approved under the `disabled` verifier binding.

DatabaseConfig.description:
The PostgreSQL connection a stateful runtime uses. Both URLs are secret
references and may name the same secret.

migrationUrlRef.description: Secret reference to the migration connection URL.

runtimeUrlRef.description: Secret reference to the least-privileged runtime connection URL.

testOnlyPlaintext.description: Allow a plaintext connection. Refused outside test builds.

trustedRootCertificateRef.description:
Secret reference to a PEM root certificate the connection trusts.
Absent, the connection trusts the platform's root certificates.

DestinationsConfig.description: Where the project's hooks deliver, by destination id.

hooks.description:
Logical URL hook destinations. The project names only these ids; the
URL, signing key, and delivery budget stay deployment-owned. At most
128 are bound, each keyed by a local identifier.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

EnvironmentSecretProviderConfig.description: The environment secret provider. It takes no settings.

Erasure.description:
Whether erasure work runs. `paused` stops every erasure and the sweep
of orphaned objects; a removal request still stops release at once, and
lapsed uploads are still expired.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

root.description:
Absolute directory holding one file per secret. Each file must be a
regular file owned by the runtime user, mode 0400 or 0600, with exactly
one hard link.

JwksSource.description: Where a runtime obtains the OIDC issuer's signing keys.

oneOf.description: Read `jwks_uri` from the issuer's OpenID Connect discovery document.

Fetch the key set from this absolute `https` URI, skipping discovery.
A plain `http` URI is accepted on loopback for supervised local
development, and beyond loopback only when the issuer block sets
`allowInsecureHttp`.

Read the key set from a secret, for deployments without network access
to the issuer.

ListenerBind.description: Socket address the runtime listens on, written host:port with an IP address host ([addr]:port for IPv6).

ListenerNetworkExposure.description: The operator-declared private network placement of an HTTP listener.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

OidcConfig.description:
The OIDC issuer whose access tokens this runtime accepts, the clients it
admits, and the claim carrying their scopes.

allowInsecureHttp.description:
Permit plain HTTP beyond loopback to the configured issuer and to a
JWKS URI declared in configuration. TLS remains required unless the
operator explicitly accepts this transport risk.

allowedClients.description:
Client identifiers whose access tokens are admitted. Required in every
file; an omitted or empty list, an empty or repeated client, and
`unrestricted` are refused.

assertionIssuers.description:
Assertion authorities each client may exchange a subject token from,
keyed by client identifier. Omitted, no assertion-issuer rule applies;
written, it lists at least one client, each with at least one
authority. Once a client is listed, a token it exchanged is accepted
only for one of that client's declared authorities, and a client that
is not listed may exchange from no authority.

audience.description: The audience every accepted access token must carry in `aud`.

issuer.description:
Exact issuer accepted in access-token `iss` claims, an absolute
`https` URL, or a plain `http` URL when `allowInsecureHttp` is set.

jwksSource.description:
Where the issuer's signing keys come from. Absent reads the issuer's
OpenID Connect discovery document.

PackageConfig.description:
The package a runtime serves: `root` is the absolute package directory,
and `expectedDigest`, when set, pins the package digest the runtime must
find there. The package digest is the digest of the package's
`SHA256SUMS` file; see [`crate::package`].

expectedDigest.description:
`sha256:` label of the package digest, the digest of the package's
`SHA256SUMS` file. When set, the runtime refuses to start on any other
package.

root.description: Absolute path of the package directory.

PrivateListenerConfig.description:
The listener of a runtime that declares its TLS termination and network
exposure.

RetentionConfig.description:
Retention periods, in days. A jurisdiction's retention schedule approves
the deployed values; the bounds only keep a typo from becoming a policy.

SecretProvidersConfig.description:
The secret providers a runtime enables. A reference is resolved only by a
provider declared here: `secret:file/name` under `file.root`, and
`secret:env/NAME` only when `environment: {}` is present.

environment.description:
Enables `secret:env/NAME` references, read from the process
environment. Declared as an empty mapping: `environment: {}`.

file.description: Enables `secret:file/name` references, read from files under `root`.

SecretReference.description: An exact secret reference: secret:file/name, resolved under secretProviders.file.root, or secret:env/NAME, resolved only when secretProviders.environment is declared.

StorageConfig.description: Where document version bytes are held.

oneOf.description: Document version bytes held in PostgreSQL `bytea`.

maximumDocumentBytes.description:
The deployment ceiling on one document version; a policy's
mandatory restriction may only be lower. Omitted, 16 MiB.

oneOf.description:
Document version bytes held in one S3-compatible bucket, under
server-chosen opaque keys.

attemptTimeoutMilliseconds.description: The longest one request may run, body included. Omitted, 10000.

bucket.description: The bucket name: lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `.`.

caBundleRef.description:
PEM CA bundle for the service. Omitted, the platform's trusted roots
verify it.

maximumDocumentBytes.description:
The deployment ceiling on one document version; a policy's
mandatory restriction may only be lower. Omitted, 16 MiB.

pathStyle.description:
Address the bucket as a path under `url` rather than as a host name.
Omitted, `true`.

region.description: The signing region: lowercase letters, digits and `-`.

url.description:
The service's base URL, with no path. It is `https`; `http` is
accepted only for a loopback host, for local development.

TlsTermination.description:
Declares the trusted transport boundary for a runtime's plaintext HTTP
listener. Production listeners require operator-controlled upstream TLS
termination; direct plaintext is limited to the explicit loopback-only
development mode.

TransfersConfig.description:
How long one upload or download may take: a floor, plus an allowance
for every mebibyte the document carries. A transfer still running at its
deadline is cut off and lets go of its bytes.

mebibyteAllowanceSeconds.description: The time added for every started mebibyte of the document.

minimumDeadlineSeconds.description: The deadline of the smallest transfer.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host preserved as written, no user information, and no backslash, whitespace or control character. DNS case and equivalent IPv6 literals are permitted.

UrlHookDestinationConfig.description:
One URL hook destination a runtime signs and sends hook deliveries to:
the URL, the HMAC-SHA256 key reference, and the delivery budget. The
outbound policy is fixed: `registry-platform-hooks` activates it with no
private address range and no client certificate. A runtime whose
destinations need either configures its own full outbound policy instead.

attemptTimeoutMilliseconds.description:
How long one delivery attempt may take, from 100 through 10000
milliseconds.

maximumAttempts.description: How many delivery attempts one event gets, from 1 through 20.

url.description:
An https URL, or http on 127.0.0.1, localhost, or [::1], without a
query or fragment.

identity.description:
Optional in the type so a missing block gets a refusal naming the key
to add; the document requires it.
